categories.name: Billing & Payments
categories.description: All issues related to invoices, charges, payments, refunds, and account balances.

subcategories.name: Incorrect Charge on Invoice
subcategories.description: Customer was billed an amount not matching their plan, contract, or prior quote.

subcategories.name: Duplicate Payment Deducted
subcategories.description: Same invoice or transaction was charged more than once in a billing cycle.

subcategories.name: Refund Not Received
subcategories.description: Approved refund has not been credited within the committed SLA window.

subcategories.name: Promotional Discount Not Applied
subcategories.description: An advertised or agent-committed promotional rate was not reflected on the bill.

subcategories.name: Early Termination Fee Dispute
subcategories.description: Customer disputes the early termination fee amount or believes it was applied in error.

categories.name: Network & Connectivity
categories.description: Complaints about signal quality, outages, dropped calls, slow data speeds, and coverage gaps.

subcategories.name: No Signal / Complete Outage
subcategories.description: Customer has zero mobile signal or complete loss of broadband connectivity.

subcategories.name: Slow Data Speeds
subcategories.description: Experienced data speeds are significantly below the plan's advertised or contracted speeds.

subcategories.name: Frequent Dropped Calls
subcategories.description: Voice calls disconnect mid-conversation without user action.

subcategories.name: Intermittent Connectivity
subcategories.description: Connection is unstable, cutting in and out repeatedly during active sessions.

categories.name: Device & Equipment
categories.description: Issues with NexaLink-provided or subsidized devices, routers, set-top boxes, and SIM cards.

subcategories.name: Defective Device Received
subcategories.description: Device provided by NexaLink arrived damaged, non-functional, or fails within the warranty period.

subcategories.name: Router / Mesh Node Malfunction
subcategories.description: NexaDevice Hub unit is not functioning, overheating, or failing to propagate a stable Wi-Fi signal.

subcategories.name: SIM Card Not Working
subcategories.description: Physical or eSIM is not provisioned, rejected by the handset, or lost activation after a plan change.

categories.name: Account Management
categories.description: Problems with account access, plan changes, profile updates, and subscription management.

subcategories.name: Unable to Access Account / Login Failure
subcategories.description: Customer cannot log in to the NexaLink app or web portal using their credentials.

subcategories.name: Plan Upgrade / Downgrade Not Applied
subcategories.description: Requested plan change was accepted but the new plan is not active on the account.

subcategories.name: Unauthorized Account Modification
subcategories.description: Changes to the account (plan, address, contacts) were made without the account holder's consent.

categories.name: Account Security & Fraud
categories.description: Reports of unauthorized access, SIM swapping, identity theft, and fraud on the account.

subcategories.name: Unauthorized SIM Swap / Port-Out
subcategories.description: Customer's number was transferred to another SIM or carrier without their authorization.

subcategories.name: Account Takeover Suspected
subcategories.description: Third party appears to have gained control of the customer's account.

subcategories.name: Fraudulent Charges / Premium SMS Scam
subcategories.description: Charges appearing on the bill are linked to fraudulent premium services the customer did not authorize.

categories.name: International Roaming
categories.description: Complaints about roaming charges, connectivity abroad, and NexaRoam Global Pass issues.

subcategories.name: Unexpected Roaming Charges
subcategories.description: Customer incurred roaming charges while abroad despite having an active NexaRoam Global Pass or believing roaming was disabled.

subcategories.name: No Service While Roaming
subcategories.description: Device shows no signal or cannot register on a partner network in a listed roaming country.

categories.name: NexaStream TV & IPTV
categories.description: Complaints specifically about the NexaStream IPTV service including channel, streaming, and DVR issues.

subcategories.name: Constant Buffering / Poor Stream Quality
subcategories.description: Live or on-demand content buffers excessively or streams at unacceptably low resolution.

subcategories.name: Subscribed Channel Not Available
subcategories.description: A channel included in the customer's IPTV package is missing or shows an error when accessed.

subcategories.name: Cloud DVR Not Recording / Recordings Lost
subcategories.description: Scheduled recordings were not captured, or previously saved recordings have disappeared.

categories.name: Installation & Field Service
categories.description: Issues with technician visits, DSL/fiber installation, equipment setup, and missed appointments.

subcategories.name: Technician Missed Scheduled Appointment
subcategories.description: A field technician did not arrive during the agreed installation or repair window.

subcategories.name: Incomplete or Faulty Installation
subcategories.description: Technician completed the visit but the service is still not fully functional or cabling was left exposed.

subcategories.name: Property Damage During Installation
subcategories.description: The installation process resulted in damage to the customer's property (walls, furniture, landscaping).

categories.name: Number Portability & Transfer
categories.description: Requests and complaints about porting a mobile number in or out of NexaLink.

subcategories.name: Number Port-In Taking Too Long
subcategories.description: Customer's number has not been ported from their previous carrier within the regulatory timeframe.

subcategories.name: Port-In Request Rejected
subcategories.description: The porting request was declined and the customer has not received a clear reason.

subcategories.name: Port-Out Being Blocked
subcategories.description: Customer believes NexaLink is illegally obstructing or delaying their port-out to another carrier.

categories.name: Regulatory & Compliance
categories.description: Complaints involving regulatory obligations, consumer rights violations, data privacy, and contract disputes.

subcategories.name: Data Privacy Violation
subcategories.description: Customer believes their personal data was shared, misused, or disclosed without consent under applicable privacy law.

subcategories.name: Contract Terms Dispute
subcategories.description: Customer alleges that NexaLink is not honoring written contract terms or has changed terms without proper notice.

subcategories.name: Aggressive Collections or Harassment
subcategories.description: Customer reports repeated unwanted contact, threats, or harassment from NexaLink's collections or retention teams.

subcategories.name: FCC / State Regulator Referenced Complaint
subcategories.description: Customer has filed or threatens to file a complaint with the FCC, state PUC, or another regulatory authority.
